title: Grafeo connector instance config (loams.flow/v1)
description: One Loams graph's settings, read by the native protocols family (`loams_connector_protocols::grafeo`, CN2 Task 21): a client of `loams.graph.v1` over Connect (D741, R21.4). `api_key` holds a secret **name** (D189), exactly the manifest's `secrets`, and is required: an instance without it is refused (`auth: key`, R21.12).

api_key.description: A Loams API key, sent as `Authorization: Bearer`. The **name** of a secret in the namespace's store (D189), resolved when the connector connects; never the value.

sink.description: `ExecuteBatch` of a parameterised statement, one per event; the event's top-level fields are bound as `$name`, plus `$ce_id`.

atomic.description: Run each batch as one transaction, with an idempotency key digested from its event ids.

source.description: `ExecuteStream` with a cursor property: one split per label.

cursor.description: The property the source orders and resumes by.

statement.description: A custom statement with `$cursor`, `$after` and `$limit`, returning `cursor` and `eid`.

poll_interval_ms.description: Keep polling from the cursor at this interval; one pass without it.
